scientific_integrity: A self-contained exact finite-cyclic Fourier fourth-moment design theorem for two equal disjoint blocks, with a fully proved sharp packing threshold and near-threshold minimizers; elementary packet correlation and negative Pell arithmetic are used. The full motivating preprint was unavailable for complete source inspection; some priority risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Optimizers below the packing threshold are classified only for orders n=3(2a-1)-t with 0<=t<=a; no general unequal-width or arbitrary binary-aperture result is asserted. Finite checks are not a proof, and independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp cyclic two-block Fourier energy and Pell-resonant optimal spacings
